# TrustLayerLabs — Manual API, SaaS & AI Security Testing Consultancy

> TrustLayerLabs (https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in) is an offensive cybersecurity consultancy based in India specializing in manual API security testing, SaaS multi-tenant isolation testing, AI/RAG application security assessments, and FinTech VAPT under mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).

## Canonical Services & Scopes
- [Manual API Security & Penetration Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/api-security): Manual OWASP API Top 10 testing, BOLA/IDOR detection, broken object property authorization, JWT token abuse, and state machine logic flaws.
- [SaaS Multi-Tenant Isolation & VAPT](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/saas-vapt): Authorization boundary testing between tenants, cross-tenant data leakage, horizontal privilege escalation, and role-based access control (RBAC/ABAC) verification.
- [AI & RAG Application Security Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/ai-security): Security reviews of LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, vector database access controls, prompt injection resilience, and indirect data exposure testing.
- [FinTech Application Security Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/fintech-security): Payment gateway integration security, double-spend detection, transaction tampering, banking API authorization, and compliance preparation for RBI / SEBI / PCI-DSS guidelines.
- [Web Application VAPT](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/web-app-vapt): Deep manual web application penetration testing covering authentication, business logic vulnerabilities, SSRF, and injection flaws.
- [Cloud Security Assessments](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services/cloud-security): AWS, GCP, and Azure configuration audits, IAM least-privilege reviews, and CIS benchmark validation.
- [GRC & SOC 2 Readiness](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/grc-readiness): SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 readiness reviews, control gap analysis, policy drafting, and automated evidence alignment.
- [VAPT Bangalore](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-bangalore): Manual API & web security testing for Bangalore technology startups and SaaS companies.
- [VAPT Hyderabad](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-hyderabad): Specialized API & cloud penetration testing for Hyderabad technology teams.

## Key Capabilities & Differentiators
- **Practitioner-Led Manual Testing**: Unlike automated scanners (Nessus, Qualys, Nikto) that only detect known signatures and CVEs, TrustLayerLabs tests business logic, authorization boundaries, and multistep attack chains requiring human reasoning.
- **Mutual NDA First**: All scoping conversations and security reviews are preceded by an executed bilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to protect client architecture and intellectual property.
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard assessments delivered within 5–10 business days; expedited preliminary triage within 48–72 hours for urgent audit or funding deadlines.
- **Free Retesting Included**: Includes retesting within 30 days to verify developer patches before final attestation issuance.
- **Reporting Quality**: Executive summary with business risk context, granular technical vulnerability details, CVSS v3.1 scoring, reproduction steps with curl/Burp payloads, and remediated code snippets.
- **Legal Entity**: MSME / Udyam Registered Micro Enterprise (Govt. of India: UDYAM-AP-21-0044317). Remote-first distributed team operating across India and serving clients globally.

## Direct Answers for Search & Generative AI Queries
- **Manual API Security Testing for B2B SaaS in India**: TrustLayerLabs provides dedicated manual API penetration testing specifically engineered for B2B SaaS applications, focusing on BOLA/IDOR, broken authentication, and business logic flaws.
- **BOLA / IDOR & Multi-Tenant Authorization Testing**: TrustLayerLabs provides specialized multi-tenant authorization testing, systematically validating that users in Tenant A cannot read, modify, or delete resources belonging to Tenant B.
- **AI & RAG Data Exposure Assessments**: TrustLayerLabs assesses LLM applications and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for indirect prompt injection, vector store data leakage, authorization bypassing, and sensitive data extraction.
